page_title: FRE 2-1 HAM | Freiburg v Hamburger SV 10/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+12' Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) is booked for saying more than Timo Gerach was willing to tolerate.
90+11' Surely that's handball by one of the Freiburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+8' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
90+7' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Timo Gerach ignores the protests.
90+5' The ball is laid off to Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Noah Atubolu to make a decent save.
90+5' The free kick from long range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+4' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Johan Manzambi is replaced by Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
90+2' It is time for a substitution. Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) is on for Albert Sambi Lokonga.
90' There will be a minimum of 11 min. of added time.
90' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post.
89' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Merlin Polzin isn't happy on the touchline after referee Timo Gerach shows him a yellow card.
87' Shots on target – 7:4.
86' Timo Gerach blows for a foul after Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
83' 2 - 1 Goal! Jan-Niklas Beste manages to prod the ball to Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the roof of the net. 2:1.

82' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Noah Atubolu pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
80' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Hamburger SV, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
79' Here comes a substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) is brought on as a substitute for Philipp Treu.
79' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. Fabio Vieira will be replaced by Guilherme Ramos (Hamburger).
78' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) replaces Bakery Jatta.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) is coming onto the pitch as Damion Downs cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Timo Gerach's book.
77' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.
76' That's unlucky! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
75' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
73' The attendance is 34700.
72' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.

69' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the bottom right corner, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
65' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Vincenzo Grifo and he is replaced by Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg).
65' The game has come to an end for Lucas Holer. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Igor Matanovic (Freiburg).
65' Timo Gerach has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matthias Ginter (Freiburg).
63' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) for a tough tackle.
62' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
59' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
57' Merlin Polzin is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jean-Luc Dompe suffers an injury and Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) comes on.

56' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Daniel Heuer Fernandes. This effort really didn't trouble him.
53' 1 - 1 Goal! Daniel Heuer Fernandes gets a hand on the penalty from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg), but can't stop it from flying into the middle of the goal.
53' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is going to take the penalty!
51' RED CARD! Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Timo Gerach. He can have an early bath.

51' Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Timo Gerach blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Freiburg are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
48' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
48' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
48' Hamburger SV have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Hamburger SV will have a corner.
47' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Hamburger SV will take a corner.
47' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' Julian Schuster has made a change at the break. Anthony Jung (Freiburg) has come on in place of Philipp Lienhart.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hamburger SV.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) fires the resulting free kick to the left side of the goal from the edge of the box, but Noah Atubolu pulls off a superb save to deny him.
43' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
42' Damion Downs (Hamburger) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
41' Good chance! Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
39' The referee shows the yellow card to Philipp Treu (Freiburg).
39' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Timo Gerach stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
35' My Gran could have done better! Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
35' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
29' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
29' He should have scored! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
26' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) brings his opponent down. Timo Gerach has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
23' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Timo Gerach signals.

19' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Daniel Heuer Fernandes is alert and denies him with a nice save.
18' The Freiburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

14' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies low towards the middle of the net, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

13' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
13' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) takes a direct free kick.
10' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.
7' A cross by Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
4' Timo Gerach shows the yellow card to Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) for a heavy challenge.

4' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Timo Gerach with no other option than to blow for a foul.
3' Damion Downs (Hamburger) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Hamburger SV will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Timo Gerach.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
